BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has purchased 1,750,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £50 million share repurchase program, with transactions occurring between April 20 and April 24, 2026. The volume-weighted average price paid per share across these purchases was approximately 265.78 pence. Following these transactions, Barratt Redrow holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,412,446,582, representing the total number of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 27 April 2026 27 April 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transactions in own shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 20 April 2026 to 24 April 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from UBS AG London Branch ("UBS") as part of its £50 million share repurchase programme announced on 5 January 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from UBS as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,412,446,582 ordinary shares in issue.
